data.one_liner: A Flutter avatar widget with automatic initials fallback and multi-source image support.
data.what_it_does: Avatar Brick wraps network, asset, file, and memory images behind a consistent API while automatically falling back to initials when no photo is available. It provides styling for size, shape, borders, shadows, and colors.
use_when: You need user avatars or profile pictures that support both photos and initials fallbacks
You want a unified API for network, asset, file, and memory images with shared styling
You need non-circular avatars with custom borders and shadows
avoid_when: You need to use SVGs directly via flutter_svg
You want cached_network_image integration out of the box
You need the initials fallback to trigger automatically on a network image load error
strengths: One consistent API across all image sources
Automatic initials generation from full names
No extra dependencies outside of the Flutter SDK
Customizable size, shapes, borders, and shadows
weaknesses: Does not support SVG widgets directly
Network image load failure renders empty space rather than switching to initials

alternatives.name: octo_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Advanced image loading with built-in placeholder and error builders for network images.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need network image caching and custom placeholder/error widgets.
